definition: A lane that receives comparatively more [ganks](/term/gank) from their teammates. Designating a lane as a team’s strongside (strongsiding) incentivizes the strongsided player to play more aggressively, since they are more likely to receive assistance with their [plays](/term/play). Strongsiding can help swing a volatile [matchup](/term/matchup) or snowball an already advantaged lane at the cost of creating a [weakside](/term/weakside).
